reason: Version 1 keeps every fact, number, commitment, and caveat with only light rewording. Version 2 makes small shifts: 'capture' becomes 'serve', it drops 'targeted', and it recasts mitigations as firm 'we will' commitments. Version 3 drops or distorts many specifics, including the no-penalty exit, the six-month outreach, redeployment and severance, and the multi-year lock-in rationale, and it overstates the mall traffic decline as a certainty.
